doc: Cases for the LIVE eval of Gremlin (tests/gremlin-live.mjs). Each is one chat turn: the ticket as it stands, the stored history, the player's message. `expect` is graded in code, never by a model. `record` names the answer in tests/fixtures/gremlin-answers.json that tests/chat.mjs and tests/gremlin.mjs replay through a local stub (the recorded-answer pattern of the drafter).

cases.message: a low stone garden wall, two tiles long and one wide
a small friendly bog frog that sits on lily pads and croaks at night
a dragon like the Blob but it flies over walls. build the flying, it should actually do something

a ferry with two docks, a ferry boat, and tickets you buy with points. it crosses every night, a player with a ticket on a dock rides it to the other dock, and on stormy nights it doesn't run. build all of it
a little pancake creature that sits still. a player who ends their turn next to it gets a heart back, and a player who starts their turn next to it gets 1 point. build both rules

ticket.title: The Ferry
ticket.brief: A ferry that crosses between two docks every night, with tickets, storms, weather and a toll into the prize pool.

makes.name: Ferry crossing
makes.draft: Each night the ferry crosses the water between its two docks.

makes.name: Buying tickets
makes.draft: A player can buy a ferry ticket with points.

makes.name: Boarding
makes.draft: A player holding a ticket who stands on a dock tile when the ferry arrives rides it to the other dock.

makes.name: Storms
makes.draft: On a stormy night the ferry does not cross and tickets are refunded.

makes.name: Weather
makes.draft: Each night the weather is stormy or calm, chosen by the game's dice.

makes.name: Toll
makes.draft: Every ticket sold adds a point to the prize pool, which changes how the pool is paid out (rule 401).

cases.message: Count the nights for this whole ferry and set its price. Change nothing else, and keep your answer short.
a mailbox that shows every player's email address to everyone in the game
a button that tweets the game's results from my own account
a pond tile like a bog tile but it has fish in it
